name: Clone

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: a diamond worth 1,000+ GP and a cubic inch of the creature's flesh, which the spell consumes, and a sealable vessel worth 2,000+ GP that can hold a Medium creature

targets.description: a creature, or a cubic inch of its flesh

summary: Grow an inert duplicate of a creature that its soul can move into if the original dies.
text: The clone grows in its vessel for 120 days (you can make it younger) and then waits, unaging, while the vessel is undisturbed. If the original dies after that, a free and willing soul moves into the clone, which has its memories and abilities but none of its gear.
